title: Top Local SEO Sydney Strategies To Boost Your Business Visibility

facts.fact: The article was published on September 11, 2025.
The page states that around 93% of consumers search using localized search terms to find services in their vicinity, with no named source given.
facts.quote: Around 93% of consumers search using localized search terms to find services in their vicinity

facts.fact: Storytellers Australia, named on the page as an example of a local SEO agency, says it has over seven years of experience.
facts.quote: With over seven years of experience and an in-house team based in North Sydney, Storytellers Australia is well-equipped to navigate the local digital marketing landscape.

facts.fact: The page says local SEO agencies use SEMrush tools to conduct keyword research, analyze competitors, and track performance metrics.
facts.quote: Local SEO agencies utilize SEMrush tools to: Conduct keyword research Analyze competitors Track performance metrics

facts.fact: The page lists the components of a local SEO audit as website performance, local backlinks, Google Business Profile accuracy, and local citations.
facts.quote: This process involves evaluating various aspects of your online presence, including: Your website’s performance Local backlinks Google Business Profile accuracy Local citations

facts.fact: The page states that structured data provides detailed information about a business, such as location and services offered, enabling search engines to display rich snippets in search results.
facts.quote: Structured data provides detailed information about your business, such as location and services offered, enabling search engines to display rich snippets in search results.
